name: BPO American (Partner)
desc:
CSR ( no previous exp needed) | Equipment NOT provided | $13.00 - $16.00/hr Starting (raises at 90 days-6 months) | Phone, Chat, and Email, BYOE (Bring Your Own Equipment)
Company: BPO American
Industry: Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) | Multi-Client Customer Service
What Your Day Will Look Like:
BPO American is a smaller, US-based BPO founded in 2005 (with roots going back to 2001), handling contact center work across multiple client accounts through calls, chat, email, and text. This role explicitly requires no prior experience, they're upfront that they're building people from zero, providing the training and tech exposure needed to gain real customer service experience.
Because BPO American serves multiple clients, schedule flexibility is a real, central part of this job, not a minor detail. Per direct conversation with their HR contact, shifts can include splits, 4x10s, overnights, evenings, and weekends across a 24-hour call center operation, and shift assignments can change based on business needs (one example given: a shift running 1-10 for six months before shifting to 12-8 as needs changed). Their honest advice to WRO: if you tell them you have full availability, be prepared to actually work anytime, don't commit to "anytime" if you actually need consistency, be upfront about real availability limits (like needing Mondays off) since schedules are customizable around genuine constraints.
assessment:
Yes, but per their HR contact, it's less about the score and more about gauging genuine interest and whether someone will follow through and complete instructions. It's administered after an initial recruiter call.

Typing and critical thinking skills/problem solving
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED.
 Required Experience: None required. This role is explicitly built for candidates with zero experience.
 Preferred Experience: Licensed agent experience is being sought for one specific client account, per their HR contact, this is a gap they haven't been able to fill in the past.
 Required Skills:
Genuine availability and trustworthiness, per their HR contact, these matter as much as any technical skill
Comfort with a schedule that can shift based on business needs
Time management (flagged directly by their HR contact as a common challenge for candidates without prior work experience)
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with zero customer service experience who wants real, paid training and a genuine first foothold in the field
Participants who are honest about their actual schedule limitations upfront rather than claiming full flexibility they can't sustain
Anyone who already owns qualifying equipment (Windows 11 computer, USB noise-canceling headset, hardwired internet), since this is a bring-your-own-equipment role
People who value co-working space access, BPO American offers 24-hour co-working space eligibility, which solves the equipment problem for someone without a home setup
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants who need a confirmed, fixed schedule from the start, this role is explicit that "anytime availability" claims will be taken literally
Anyone without qualifying computer equipment and no interest in using a co-working space instead
Someone whose only real availability constraint is one they haven't clearly communicated, per their HR contact, unclear availability upfront causes problems later

previous call center or customer interactions, ability to handle payments into a system
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Applicants apply then must watch their email for an interview invite. 
After the initial recruiter call, an assessment is sent to gauge interest and follow-through rather than being heavily scored. 
 Interviewing happens roughly 2 weeks before each class start date, so timing matters, applicants who apply too early relative to the class start have sometimes taken other jobs before BPO American reaches out. 
Training runs 8-5 Eastern or 9-5, Monday-Friday, first shift, and is paid.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell me honestly about your actual availability, including any days or times you truly cannot work.
How do you manage your time when you don't have a fixed daily routine yet?
What does being reliable and trustworthy in a new job mean to you?
Are you comfortable with a schedule that might change based on business needs every few months?
What interests you about starting a customer service career with no prior experience required?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $13.00-$1600/hr . First raise typically comes at 90 days to 6 months.
Shift: Full-time, 24-hour call center operation. Highly flexible/variable shifts: splits, 4x10s, overnights, evenings, weekends. No swing shifts offered, but shift assignments can and do change based on business needs. 

Training: 8-5 Eastern or 9-5, Monday-Friday, first shift.
Benefits: Employees go through a staffing agency (Paramount Staffing) first for benefits administration, not immediately hired direct. Insurance, PTO, and 401(k) become available once brought on permanently.
Equipment Provided: No. Bring-your-own-equipment (BYOE) role: must have a Windows 11 computer (not strictly required, but preferred), USB noise-canceling headset, and a hardwired internet connection. Co-working space access is available and encouraged for anyone without a suitable home setup.
Felony Friendly?: Genuinely clear and specific, straight from their HR contact: fraud and compromised payment information charges are a hard no, but they are not concerned about felony drug charges. WRO does not run its own background check for this partnership, BPO America handles it as part of their own process, and it's described as informal ("a simple search, nothing formal"), not a deep, formal background investigation.
Drug Test: No current drug test, and the role is explicitly OMMA (Oklahoma Medical Marijuana Authority) friendly.
Notes: Direct partnership. This company is actively hiring 8-10 from a cohort of 20 WRO applicants per class. Class dates are set specifically to align with WRO's training schedule, applications should be timed carefully since applying too early relative to the class start has caused past applicants to take other jobs before being reached. Emphasize radical honesty about availability during the application and interview process, this was raised repeatedly and directly by their HR contact as the biggest factor in whether the partnership works well for both sides. Co-working space eligibility is a genuine differentiator here compared to their South Carolina cohort, who must purchase their own equipment.
Career Pathway: Customer Service Representative → Senior Customer Service Representative → Team Lead → Project Manager (note: BPO American's own leadership team includes multiple Project Manager titles, suggesting a real internal path) → Implementation/Operations Manager
